Here is a 150 character palindrome:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba" - this phrase, along with "Madam In Eden, I’m Adam", is one of the most well-known palindromes in English.

It can be written as follows:

A b l e   w a s   I   e r e   I   s a w   E l b a

The palindrome appears twice in this sequence.
